login_tagline: Run agents in isolated Sandboxes on your own Nodes.
sandboxes_description: Isolated environments that run commands and terminals, each started from a Snapshot.
sandboxes_empty_description: Create one to get a terminal in a fresh environment. Mounting Resources and Secrets is done with the CLI.
snapshots_description: Reusable environment images. Platform Snapshots come with this deployment and anyone can use them.
snapshots_empty_description: Create a Snapshot, then build it from a Dockerfile or import an existing image.
snapshots_new_description: Name it, then build or import its first version.
git_description: Link an account so git inside your Sandboxes can clone and push as you.
git_empty_description: Ask an administrator to add a Git provider to this deployment.
cli_token_created: You can close this tab and go back to the terminal.
cli_paste_hint: If the terminal is still waiting, paste the token into the orrery login prompt.
cli_description: Paste this token into the orrery login prompt. It is shown only once.
secrets_description: Values are write-only: once saved, they can't be viewed here again. Saving under an existing name replaces the value.
secrets_add_description: The name is the key your Sandboxes and builds use to read the value. An existing name is overwritten.
secrets_empty_description: Store API keys and passwords here so Sandboxes and builds can use them without exposing the value.
secret_error_name_too_long: Name must be at most 255 characters
account_token_created_description: Copy it now. It won't be shown again.
account_create_token_description: A token signs in the CLI, SDK or API as you.
account_expiry_future: Expiry must be in the future
audit_description: Every change made on the platform, newest first.
audit_filters_description: Leave a field empty to match everything. Times are in your local time zone.
audit_load_error: Could not load the audit log
nodes_description: Compute hosts and their GPU capacity. Enrolling a Node or declaring one lost is done with the CLI.
nodes_empty_description: Enroll a Node Agent with the CLI to give this deployment capacity.
node_not_found_description: This Node does not exist or has been deleted.
nodes_outdated: Node Agent version is behind the Control Plane; upgrade the Agent
nodes_disk_full: Free disk is below the watermark; no new allocations
users_description: People sign in through Polaris; machine users come from orrery-server user-token. Set quotas and delete users here.
users_edit_description: Identity: {identity}. Admin rights come from Polaris; set the quota here.
sandbox_status_description: Where this Sandbox is in its lifecycle.
sandbox_configuration_description: What this Sandbox was created with.
new_description: Pick a Snapshot, size it, and choose where its files live. Mounting Resources and Secrets is done with the CLI.
new_general_description: A name, the environment to start from, and when to stop it.
new_resources_description: The Sandbox is placed on a Node with this much free capacity.
new_workspace_description: A persistent Workspace keeps its files after the Sandbox is deleted. Leave it on ephemeral for throwaway work.
new_idle_stop_hint: Stops after this long with no activity. 0 keeps it running.
sandbox_form_cpu_positive: CPU must be greater than zero
sandbox_form_memory_positive: Memory must be greater than zero
execs_empty_description: Open a terminal, or start a command from the CLI, SDK or MCP.
execs_recent_description: Select one to follow its output.
execs_not_in_list: That Exec is not in this Sandbox's list.
execs_logs_hint: Output past the terminal scrollback is available with the CLI.
execs_no_selected_description: Pick an Exec from the list to follow its output here.
execs_stream_closed: The output stream closed before the Exec finished. Terminal Execs have no log; attach to the terminal instead.
terminal_connect_failed_attached: Could not connect. This Exec has no terminal, or the Sandbox is not ready.
terminal_connect_failed: Could not connect. The Sandbox may not be ready yet.
terminal_start_timeout: The Exec did not start in time.
snapshot_versions_description: Newest first. New Sandboxes start from the current version.
snapshot_versions_empty_description: Build or import one to make this Snapshot usable.
snapshot_not_in_list: That version is not in this Snapshot's list.
snapshot_no_build_log: Imported versions have no build log.
build_log_closed: The build log stream closed before the build finished.
build_log_queued: Waiting for build capacity. The log appears when the build starts.
ports_description: Open a port served inside the Sandbox in a new tab. The link is valid for one minute.
ports_blocked: The browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups and try again.
exec_truncation_notice: [output truncated — full log available via the CLI]
snapshot_form_secret_incomplete: Each build Secret needs both an id and a Secret
snapshot_form_secret_duplicate: This id is already used by another build Secret
version_new_description: Build from a Dockerfile, or import an existing image by tag or digest.
version_new_from_description: Prefilled from version {version}. Change what you need and create.
version_new_base_hint: Available to the Dockerfile as FROM base.
version_new_secrets_hint: Read them in the Dockerfile with RUN --mount=type=secret,id=<id>.
version_new_contexts_hint: Extra build contexts can be added with the CLI.
version_new_contexts_kept: Build contexts carried over from the earlier version: {names}
version_new_ref_hint: For example python:3.12 or registry/image@sha256:…. A tag is pinned to its digest when you create the version.
resources_description: Versioned, read-only file trees that Sandboxes can mount. Publish one from a Sandbox's files or push it with `orrery resource push`.
resources_empty_description: Open a Sandbox, select a file or directory and choose Publish. Or push one with `orrery resource push`.
resource_versions_empty_description: Publishing or pushing creates the first version.
resource_not_in_list: That version is not in this Resource's list.
resource_manifest_truncated: Showing the first {shown} of {total} entries; use the CLI for the rest.
workspaces_description: Working directories that live on one Node. A persistent Workspace keeps its files across Sandboxes; open an attached Sandbox to browse them.
workspaces_empty_description: Create a persistent Workspace, then pick it when you create a Sandbox. Ephemeral Workspaces are created and deleted with their Sandbox.
workspace_delete_confirm: Delete Workspace {id} and all its files?
workspace_files_hint: To browse files, open a ready Sandbox that has this Workspace attached.
resource_download_missing: The server returned no download URL.
sandbox_delete_description: The Sandbox stops and is removed. An ephemeral Workspace and its files go with it; a persistent Workspace is kept.
sandbox_terminal_not_ready: Available once the Sandbox is ready
sandbox_ready_hint: Files and ports appear here once the Sandbox is ready.
secret_delete_description: Sandboxes and builds that read it will no longer find it. The value can't be recovered.
secrets_replace_description: The old value is overwritten and can't be recovered.
token_revoke_description: Anything signed in with this token stops working immediately.
session_revoke_description: That browser is signed out immediately.
session_revoke_current_description: This is the browser you are using now. You will be signed out.
account_tokens_description: For the CLI, SDK and scripts. Revoking takes effect immediately.
account_no_api_tokens: No tokens yet. Create one to use the CLI or API.
account_sessions_description: Sign out any browser you no longer use.
git_unlink_description: git inside your Sandboxes can no longer clone or push as you on {provider}.
users_cannot_delete_self: You can't delete your own account
files_publish_description: Publishes {path} as a new version of the Resource. A name that doesn't exist yet creates the Resource.
sandbox_stopped_hint: Start the Sandbox to browse its files and open ports.
